workflows.label: Cash and accrual books
workflows.quote: Rent Manager’s double-entry accounting system is equipped to handle every aspect of your finances. Whether you manage one community or thousands of properties, our customizable system allows you to gain complete control over your accounting data with time-saving accounts payable and receivable processes. Rent Manager functions in cash and accrual accounting simultaneously. Manage everything from one-time transactions to electronic bank reconciliations in a single user-friendly program.

workflows.label: Receivable cycle
workflows.quote: Maintain your monthly A and R processing cycle with Rent Manager. Handling receivables has never been easier—charge, receive, and deposit payments through our streamlined accounting system.

workflows.label: Scheduled collection notices
workflows.quote: Create a seamless Accounts Receivable schedule. Deliver notices via email, text, phone broadcast, or Virtual Post Office based on your predetermined schedule and protocol. Alerts are personalized for various levels of delinquency.

workflows.label: Charge types
workflows.quote: Create Charge Types to track the services and products that your business offers. Once established, post charges for rent, late fees, storage, parking, and more.

workflows.label: Recorded payments
workflows.quote: Receive payments for everything from one-time charges, recurring charges, late fees, etc. Record payments on your contacts’ transaction ledgers to accurately reflect your monthly income.

workflows.label: Bank deposits
workflows.quote: Once payments are received and recorded, deposits can be made within Rent Manager. Deposit funds and easily connect them to the correct property and bank account.

workflows.label: Payable bills
workflows.quote: Easily create and pay one-time bills received from vendors. Entering bills into Rent Manager allows you to track the amounts, due dates, and which properties they’re associated with.

workflows.label: Recurring payable bills
workflows.quote: If you manage properties that receive bills on a regular cycle—such as trash, internet service, or sewage bills—you can save time by creating and posting them as Recurring Bills.

workflows.label: Vendor records
workflows.quote: Tracking vendors is a crucial piece of Accounts Payable. Create vendor accounts in your database to keep contact information, preferred payment methods, transactions, and communication history on file and at-hand.

workflows.label: Corporate card register
workflows.quote: The Credit Card register displays the charges, credits, and payments associated with your credit card accounts. Pay bills with credit cards and electronically reconcile in Rent Manager.

workflows.label: Printed checks
workflows.quote: Managing your checks in Rent Manager gives you the organizational tools to track when checks were written, which properties were expensed, and the check amount. You can even print checks directly from the software.

workflows.label: Owner and vendor money transfers
workflows.quote: Electronically process tenant payments, owner contributions and distributions, and vendor bills through Rent Manager in real time. One-time transactions, batch payments, recurring disbursements—these integrated receivable and payable capabilities help keep you and your customers up-to-date and on time.

workflows.label: Online card and check payments
workflows.quote: No more trips to the bank! Process credit card and check payments online in real time with Zego’s ePay integration.

workflows.label: Retail cash rent
workflows.quote: CashPay gives tenants the freedom to electronically pay rent using cash at any of the 30,000 CheckFreePay locations nationwide.

workflows.label: Check scanning and lockbox
workflows.quote: Using Rent Manager’s convenient check scanners, you can link and process multiple checks at once. Or outsource check scanning entirely with Lockbox, powered by Zego.

workflows.label: Vendor payment automation
workflows.quote: Pay your vendors exactly how they want to be paid at no additional cost to you. Ditch manual check writing for good and automate your payables using AvidPay.

workflows.label: Bank sync
workflows.quote: Securely connect your bank and credit card accounts to Rent Manager, allowing real-world transactions to be seamlessly synced and reconciled using AI-assisted technology. See if your bank is compatible:

workflows.label: Receipt image to payable
workflows.quote: Tracking expenses on the go has never been easier. Simply snap a photo of a receipt, and Smart Receipts will extract and categorize the expense data, automatically creating a payable in Rent Manager.

workflows.label: Automatic bill extraction
workflows.quote: Eliminate the hassle of manual invoice entry by automatically capturing key data points from bills, categorizing them, and generating payables in Rent Manager.

workflows.label: Handwritten check recognition
workflows.quote: Automatically read check details—including handwritten amounts—in Rent Manager to minimize errors, save time, and effortlessly review and post batches, even at high volumes.

workflows.label: Financial statements
workflows.quote: Rent Manager’s top-notch financial reporting features organize and summarize your financial data in a comprehensive and customizable format. Accounting staples like the Balance Sheet, General Ledger, and Profit & Loss can be generated in seconds in both cash and accrual accounting bases.

workflows.label: Vendor and owner tax filing
workflows.quote: Between your daily responsibilities and planning for the year ahead, finding time to navigate the road of proper 1099 filing can feel almost impossible. With Rent Manager’s comprehensive and easy-to-use tools, tax season doesn’t have to be a stress-fueled few weeks. You can access our top 8 tips for year-end close by downloading our free Year-End Close eBook. Generate vendor and owner 1099s, verify amounts, enter expenses, and other essential tax time duties.

workflows.label: Company budget warnings
workflows.quote: Plan your finances with Rent Manager’s comprehensive budgeting features. Measure income, track expenses, and develop informed financial projections. To ensure your company spending is on track, set budget warnings to appear on financial transactions that may approach or exceed your budget goals.

workflows.label: Purchase orders and inventory
workflows.quote: Stay organized and maintain a historical record of your purchases. Set statuses to easily determine which purchases are pending, approved, or denied. Establish workflows to create and reply to purchase orders in an efficient manner. Purchase orders can also be linked to bills or invoices, and when the items are received, the quantity can directly increase the number of available inventory items.

workflows.label: Owner-financed loans
workflows.quote: Loan Manager simplifies home loan complexities by enabling you to track thousands of owner-financed loans within Rent Manager. This comprehensive feature eliminates the need for third-party loan programs and lets you to charge principal and interest amounts directly to the tenant, just like rent charges.

workflows.label: Metered utility billing
workflows.quote: Simplify utility billing with Rent Manager. Every billing period, you enter in your meter readings for gas, water, electric, and sewage. Once utilities have been calculated and posted, you can quickly charge your tenants for their consumption right within the program. This streamlined method keeps a record of your tenants’ and units’ consumption history while ensuring this crucial piece of property management is incorporated into your software.

workflows.label: Commercial charge reconciliation
workflows.quote: Rent Manager’s Commercial Module enables you to manage various commercial charges and reconcile them against commercial expenses. Easily calculate, distribute, and reconcile one-time and recurring charges associated with your properties. Produce versatile, informative statements for your tenants, owners, and vendors with the program’s comprehensive collection of commercial property reports.

workflows.label: Service issue tracking
workflows.quote: Service issues help your team organize and stay ahead of your ever-changing list of maintenance tasks. Create, track, manage, and resolve service issues from within your database. Turn service management into a revenue generator for your business with Rent Manager.

workflows.label: Service issue statuses
workflows.quote: Thoroughly track your maintenance progress with Service Issue Statuses. Statuses describe the current condition of your project—New, Work in Progress, Resolved, etc. Sort your issue list by status as you’re filtering through which assignments need to be resolved.

workflows.label: Field completion and resident signoff
workflows.quote: rmAppSuite Pro users can manage and update the service issue stage on their smart device while they’re still on the job. Project progress can be updated in real time and tenants can electronically sign off on completed work.

workflows.label: Memorized service issues
workflows.quote: Avoid redundant data entry with Memorized Service Issues. If you create issues for the same maintenance tasks over and over again, memorize them to save the name, description, and other issue details, so you can populate the form in the future with just one click.

workflows.label: Issue assignment and notifications
workflows.quote: Efficiently delegate maintenance tasks by assigning service issues to other Rent Manager users. Users can even create an Automated Notification to alert them when they’ve been assigned a new task.

workflows.label: Technician working hours and calendar
workflows.quote: Our Maintenance Scheduling tool offers a simplified approach for maintenance coordinators to establish workflows that efficiently manage their technicians’ schedules and day-to-day repair and upkeep appointments. Easily group properties and technicians to manage availability and input your maintenance team’s working hours effortlessly. Plus, the Tech View in the rmAppSuite Pro mobile app allows employees to quickly review their daily schedules any time, anywhere.

workflows.label: Resident service time slots
workflows.quote: Further, residents can use Rent Manager’s Tenant Web Access (TWA) portal or the rmResident mobile app to select time slots to schedule service requests—saving you and them valuable time. And automated notifications can be sent directly from Rent Manager Express when requests are created, scheduled, confirmed, and closed—keeping everyone informed.

workflows.label: Issue checklists
workflows.quote: Manage and conquer your to-do list with Issue Checklists. Implement Issue Checklists for service issues that require several steps to be accomplished before final completion. Create a checklist item for each step of the process. When a step is finished and marked as completed in Rent Manager, you can advance the issue to another user in the process—inspiring a fluid, easy-to-follow workflow.

workflows.label: Technician GPS
workflows.quote: Track your service techs’ locations and gauge productivity levels with the Service Tech Map. When an rmAppSuite Pro user checks in to a service issue, the map will update their location using the device’s GPS.

workflows.label: Integrated work billing and markup
workflows.quote: Simplify your payables and receivables by integrating billable expenses into work orders. This billing and invoicing tool allows you to charge back expenses to tenants or owners in the form of invoices, and optionally add a markup amount to each billable expense as part of the reimbursement.

workflows.label: Custom inspection templates
workflows.quote: Inspections play a major role in the maintenance process. Streamline and standardize your inspections procedures with Rent Manager. Inspection reports include important details that provide a complete picture of the inspection process. Inspection templates are completely customizable, allowing you to create assessments based on the unique specifications of each property and unit type.

workflows.label: Video inspections
workflows.quote: Take your inspection process to the next level with video inspections. This powerful tool allows you to capture videos of your property and units on your mobile device while in the Inspection feature of the rmAppSuite Pro mobile app. Once the inspection is uploaded, you can access your videos directly in Rent Manager.

workflows.label: Mobile inspection synchronization
workflows.quote: Inspections can be conducted from start to finish via the rmAppSuite Pro mobile app. Make notes, take photos, and schedule work orders in the field from your smart device—all of which is synced to Rent Manager.

workflows.label: Repairs from inspections
workflows.quote: After an inspection is complete and you’ve identified the areas that require maintenance, you can effortlessly create service issues for any items that require attention.

workflows.label: Make-ready boards
workflows.quote: The make-ready process is often costly and labor-intensive. Simplify unit turnover with organization and clear task delegation via Rent Manager’s Make Ready Board. This feature displays the units you’ve assigned a make-ready process, with color-coded statuses for associated service issues and inspections. Make your to-do lists more manageable with Make Ready Boards.

workflows.label: Utility expense recovery
workflows.quote: We handle all billing methods—including flat fee, RUBS, and sub-metering—ensuring maximum expense recovery.

workflows.label: Utility invoice collection
workflows.quote: Our integrated accounts payable solution streamlines utility invoice collection and payment, reducing administrative tasks.

workflows.label: Consolidated resident bills
workflows.quote: We combine all resident charges—from rent to utilities—into one easy-to-pay electronic bill, simplifying the payment process.

workflows.label: Utility rate review service
workflows.quote: Our rate review service ensures accurate, up-to-date utility rates, maximizing cost recovery and compliance.

workflows.label: User activity reporting
workflows.quote: View a full scope of each user’s actions inside Rent Manager. Administrators can monitor everything from user login times to crucial decisions that affect database setup and financial records. This powerful report can help isolate and correct mistakes made during data entry.

workflows.label: Corporate accounting reports
workflows.quote: These reports assist you in keeping an informed and watchful eye over your company’s finances. At its core, Rent Manager is an accounting software armed with an array of fundamental financial reports including the Balance Sheet, General Ledger, and Profit & Loss statements.

workflows.label: Budget comparison reports
workflows.quote: Rent Manager’s reporting module provides several different budget reports to analyze cash flow and company spending habits, and to compare your actual allocations against your projected budget. Reference your budget reports while you make informed financial decisions.

workflows.label: Rent roll transactions
workflows.quote: Get an immediate overview of your tenants’ transaction activity during a specified time period with the Summary Rent Roll. This report shows held security deposits and loss to lease totals, as well as a breakdown of rent and non-rent charges, payments, credits, and prior balances.

workflows.label: Owner and vendor 1099 reports
workflows.quote: Begin and end tax season with peace of mind with Rent Manager’s convenient tax tools. Easily generate vendor and owner 1099 reports—and print them onto prepared IRS 1099 forms—directly from the software. These forms can then be mailed or e-filed to satisfy IRS requirements.

workflows.label: Vacancy reports
workflows.quote: Generate the Vacancy Report to quickly identify which of your units are available and vacant. This informative report shows the length of vacancy as well as the rent amount of each unit, providing you with the information you need to turn units faster.

workflows.label: Custom operational report writer
workflows.quote: Create property, tenant, prospect, owner, vendor, and unit reports with Report Writer to reflect your business demands and control the display through a variety of different options.

workflows.label: Financial report writer
workflows.quote: Craft reports that are full of financial data crucial to your business. Make minor adjustments to existing financial reports or create entirely new reports from scratch that are full of essential accounting data—in your preferred format—with Financial Report Writer.

workflows.label: Scheduled reports
workflows.quote: Send Report Batches based on a pre-determined schedule. You have complete control over when reports are sent, and who receives them.

workflows.label: Report batches
workflows.quote: The Rent Manager Report Batches feature makes running a series of reports possible with a single click. This time-saving workflow delivers the data you need effortlessly.

workflows.label: Custom professional report service
workflows.quote: Rent Manager includes more than 450 built-in reports and you can craft your own feature-dense reports with the help of Report Writer. However, if you’re looking for something even more advanced, our Professional Services team can help! These talented Rent Manager experts can expand the capabilities of existing reports or create a report entirely from scratch, based on your specific needs.

workflows.label: Scheduled reports
workflows.quote: Rent Manager Online’s (RMO) Report Automation feature automatically generates and delivers designated Report Batches based on a schedule you set. Eliminate daily to-dos by allowing this feature to distribute vital reports—like the Balance Sheet and Profit & Loss—to your partners and owners.

workflows.label: Recipient-specific report options
workflows.quote: Tedious tasks like report generation and delivery can consume one of your most valuable resources: time. With Report Batches, users can combine a series of reports and run them simultaneously to save time and promote seamless workflows. You can also save the required options of each report to reflect the needs of specific recipients.

workflows.label: Batch frequency and shared ownership
workflows.quote: Report Automation takes the convenience and efficiency of Report Batches to the next level. This time-saving feature allows you to schedule Report Batches automatically at a set frequency, and deliver the report results via email to whomever you choose. You can easily customize and manage the list of Report Batches by reordering and sharing ownership of them with other users.

workflows.label: Failed batch delivery notification
workflows.quote: If anything happens that inhibits the delivery of a Report Batch, you will be notified via email immediately. Isolate and correct issues as they occur to ensure your reports are sent on time, every day.

workflows.label: Telephone maintenance intake
workflows.section: Live Support Whenever Your Residents Need It
workflows.quote: Call Center—powered by Anequim—provides residents and prospects alike with comprehensive, authoritative 24/7 support. Call Center agents are ready to troubleshoot, create maintenance requests, kick off the leasing process, and escalate calls based on your desired protocols.

workflows.label: Call records
workflows.section: 24/7 Assistance & Realtime Updates Built Into Rent Manager
workflows.quote: Call Center’s complete integration with Rent Manager allows a record of every call to be automatically saved in your database.

workflows.label: Caller identification
workflows.section: 24/7 Assistance & Realtime Updates Built Into Rent Manager
workflows.quote: Call Center can use information from your Rent Manager database to determine who is calling.

workflows.label: Native tickets from telephone calls
workflows.section: 24/7 Assistance & Realtime Updates Built Into Rent Manager
workflows.quote: Call Center agents instantly add maintenance requests to your system to match your current workflows.

workflows.label: Call center emergency protocols
workflows.quote: After signing up for Call Center, you’ll provide basic property details, define emergencies and dispatch protocols, and set leasing instructions; Call Center will then assign a phone number and manage calls per your instructions.

workflows.label: Call center leasing support
workflows.quote: Let the Call Center assist with your leasing process by sharing available unit information with prospective residents.

workflows.label: Call activity reports
workflows.quote: Once a quarter, you’ll receive a report detailing the number of tickets created, emergencies, complaints, and actions taken to resolve them. You can also provide feedback to the Call Center during quarterly review meetings.

workflows.label: Telephone decision trees
workflows.quote: Eliminate the guesswork for Call Center reps by providing predetermined workflows for resolving issues.

workflows.label: Mobile texts and recorded voice calls
workflows.quote: Set a solid communications precedent and increase your response times by sending text messages and making rmVoIP-integrated calls to your contacts. Every text you send via the app will appear in the contact’s History and Notes, and recordings of calls made through rmAppSuite Pro will also attach to their History and Notes, giving you a comprehensive historical record of each communication.

workflows.label: Mobile ACH cash and card acceptance
workflows.quote: ePay users can conveniently accept ACH, cash, and credit card payments via the app. Payments will be instantly reflected on the contact’s transaction ledger, ensuring your data and receivable collections are entirely up-to-date.

workflows.label: Field inspections synchronized to native records
workflows.quote: rmAppSuite Pro’s Inspections feature enables you to perform, document, and complete inspections in the field using your smart device, and then seamlessly upload the results to Rent Manager.

workflows.label: Technician inspection push notifications
workflows.quote: Your maintenance team will never miss an inspection with rmAppSuite Pro. When you assign inspections to your maintenance techs while they’re in the field, they’ll receive a push notification alerting them about the task.

workflows.label: Technician inspection templates
workflows.quote: Perform inspections from start to finish within the app. Using previously created Inspection Templates, technicians can move through the procedure with confidence as they tackle items associated with each area of a unit.

workflows.label: Inspection map directions
workflows.quote: Rather than jumping out of the app to get directions to the next inspection location, rmAppSuite Pro users can map the location of their next inspection stop with a click of a button.

workflows.label: Inspection arrival and departure communications
workflows.quote: rmAppsuite Pro facilitates communication and quick turnaround times by enabling your technicians to text, email, or call tenants linked to each inspection to establish arrival and departure times.

workflows.label: Technician GPS
workflows.quote: Add, edit, and complete tasks on the go, ensuring seamless field-to-office communication. The enhanced Service Tech Map tracks check-ins, check-outs, and provides on-demand location data, making it easy to assign tasks to the nearest technician. Technicians can also upload project photos and collect electronic tenant sign-offs, boosting efficiency and accountability.

workflows.label: Field repair photos and electronic signoff
workflows.quote: Add, edit, and complete tasks on the go, ensuring seamless field-to-office communication. The enhanced Service Tech Map tracks check-ins, check-outs, and provides on-demand location data, making it easy to assign tasks to the nearest technician. Technicians can also upload project photos and collect electronic tenant sign-offs, boosting efficiency and accountability.

workflows.label: Mobile association violations and charges
workflows.quote: You make rules for your properties, and administer violations when those rules are broken. Now, when you’re working in the field and witness a violation, you can address the issue immediately with rmAppSuite Pro. Effortlessly add a violation to a tenant’s account, access and escalate existing violations, attach photos and supporting notes, and quickly calculate the associated charges.

workflows.label: Barcode utility meter readings
workflows.quote: Entering meter readings and billing tenants for their utility consumption has never been easier. With rmAppSuite Pro, users can submit reading data from their properties while in the field. If your meters have a barcode, you can scan it with your device’s camera and then enter usage data for that meter.

workflows.label: Historical utility reading anomaly review
workflows.quote: rmAppSuite Pro displays historical readings of each meter, helping you to isolate and identify irregularities on the spot.

workflows.label: Resident online payments signatures and repairs
workflows.quote: Rent Manager’s Prospect and Tenant portal is the ultimate online resource for prospective and current renters. This secure resource gives tenants the flexibility to pay rent and other charges online, electronically sign leases, and submit maintenance requests rather than make a trip to the leasing office, which also results in fewer interruptions for you.

workflows.label: Custom online application templates
workflows.quote: Rent Manager’s online application abilities provide convenience for your prospects and quicker approval response times for your management company. Craft your own application templates that prospects can easily access and complete on your website.

workflows.label: Portal signable fields on arbitrary documents
workflows.quote: Take your leases to the next level. Signable Docs allows you to place signable fields on any document. Prospects and tenants can review and sign the documents electronically through their online portals.

workflows.label: Signed document synchronization
workflows.quote: Once you have received a signature, the document will appear in your Rent Manager database.

workflows.label: Digital leases and renewals
workflows.quote: Go digital with your leasing and renewals process. With Rent Manager, tenants can access and sign their leases from any web-enabled device—allowing you to streamline this crucial aspect of your business.

workflows.label: Credit criminal and eviction screening
workflows.quote: Uncover potential credit issues—such as late payments or accumulated debt—as well as criminal and eviction history with Rent Manager’s fully integrated Resident Screening capabilities.

workflows.label: Resident mobile payments and repairs
workflows.quote: Keep residents in the know, even when they’re on the go. rmResident is a secure, easy-to-use mobile app designed to keep renters and property managers connected. Residents can use the app to make and view payments, review work orders and submit new ones, and more. Property Managers can respond to and resolve service issues while staying in touch with renters, anywhere, at any time.

workflows.label: Prospect CRM and personalized unit letters
workflows.quote: Turn prospects into tenants with Prospect Manager. This powerful feature provides valuable insights, tools, and reports that make tracking your prospects and marketing campaigns a breeze. Tailor your message to each prospect with customizable unit profile letters to speak directly to potential tenants who have certain amenities in mind.

workflows.label: Website guest cards creating native prospects
workflows.quote: Never miss a chance to connect with future customers through strategically positioned Guest Cards. Guest Cards allow you to place a contact submission form on your custom website. Prospects browsing your site can quickly submit answers to the questions you craft via Rent Manager’s Guest Card template. These submissions also automatically generate a Prospect contact profile in your database.

workflows.label: Self-managed property website templates
workflows.quote: Build a simple yet effective website for your business with no prior development or programming experience with Web Template Suite’s easy-to-use tools.

workflows.label: Integrated professional website service
workflows.quote: Using your vision and feedback as a guideline, our team will craft an eye-catching website for your operation that fully integrates with Rent Manager—in as little as two weeks!

workflows.label: Existing website integration
workflows.quote: Integrate Rent Manager with your pre-existing website, or our developers can create a professionally designed website from scratch for your business.

workflows.label: Automatic ILS listing updates
workflows.quote: Increase your unit marketability by taking advantage of Rent Manager’s internet listing service (ILS) integrations. Effortlessly push your unit and property information from your database onto various ILS platforms. All data changes in Rent Manager automatically update on each ILS site, so you’ll never have to worry about posting an unavailable unit or listing inaccurate rates.

workflows.label: Prospect web chat with staff queues
workflows.quote: Inspire immediate, effective communication through Rent Manager’s Web Chat feature. This convenient resource enables prospects to send messages and connect with your team instantly via your website. Chats appear in the My Conversations window of your Rent Manager database, where you also have the ability to create a queue structure so every inquiry is answered promptly, by the right member of your staff.

workflows.label: Dynamic notice letters emailed exported and printed
workflows.quote: Rent Manager’s powerful Online Template Library is a continuously updated resource full of industry-standard property management letters, such as 5 Day Pay or Quit, Automatic Payment Instructions, Balance Due, and more. Customize your letters to automatically incorporate unit, property, prospect, tenant, owner, or vendor information through dynamic rmScript commands. Once complete, you can email, export, and print letters directly from the software.

workflows.label: Aerial property maps with financial indicators
workflows.quote: Bird’s Eye View allows you to build an aerial picture of a property and its associated units. Create custom maps that visually report delinquencies, vacancies, amenities, and more. This unique add-on feature is ideal for any type of property management operation. Bird’s Eye View illustrations can also be used for marketing materials, quick-reference guides, and directional maps.

workflows.label: Property maps for prospect marketing
workflows.quote: Bird’s Eye View illustrations can double as a standard property map that can be given to prospects, or used on an array of marketing materials. Apply color to your Bird’s Eye View illustrations to help easily identify different buildings and specific areas of your property.

workflows.label: Map drill-down to residents and work
workflows.quote: While you’re viewing your property from above, you can quickly drill-down on each unit to view detailed information—see who is currently occupying the unit, any outstanding maintenance requests, or look at the tenant’s records.

workflows.label: Prospect matching by mapped amenities and accessibility
workflows.quote: Having a complete picture of your units, their amenities, cost of rent, and accessibility makes it so easy to match prospects with spaces that meet their preferences. Bird’s Eye View provides a unique reporting perspective that ties essential portfolio data to a custom aerial-view map of your properties.

workflows.label: Owner contributions and equity distributions
workflows.quote: For fee-based management companies, establishing an Ownership setup in Rent Manager is a breeze. Accomplish crucial business tasks—including receiving Owner Contributions, collecting Management Fees, and paying owners their equity distributions—in a matter of a few mouse clicks. You also have the ability to give your owners access to important property and financial investment information through their own online portal.

workflows.label: Owner reserves balances distributions and fee portal
workflows.quote: Owner Web Access (OWA) allows your owners to log into a designated, customized portal to view reserves, bank balances, distributions, and management fees. Owners can generate and export Rent Manager reports to stay up to date on how their properties are doing. Your team can even upload documents to OWA and owners can review and sign documents electronically.

workflows.label: Owner generated and exported reports
workflows.quote: Owner Web Access (OWA) allows your owners to log into a designated, customized portal to view reserves, bank balances, distributions, and management fees. Owners can generate and export Rent Manager reports to stay up to date on how their properties are doing. Your team can even upload documents to OWA and owners can review and sign documents electronically.

workflows.label: Owner document signing
workflows.quote: Owner Web Access (OWA) allows your owners to log into a designated, customized portal to view reserves, bank balances, distributions, and management fees. Owners can generate and export Rent Manager reports to stay up to date on how their properties are doing. Your team can even upload documents to OWA and owners can review and sign documents electronically.

workflows.label: Management fee templates posting and transfers
workflows.quote: After paying bills and collecting receivables, efficiently calculate and post management fees in Rent Manager. Transfer funds from your managed properties’ operating bank accounts to your management company in a matter of a few clicks. Create and assign Management Fee Templates for each of your managed properties and post fees based on your specific requirements.

workflows.label: Owner prospect guest cards
workflows.quote: Owner prospects browsing your website can quickly request a follow-up call and submit details about their property—specified by you—via a Guest Card template. Their submission automatically creates an Owner Prospect account within your Rent Manager database.

workflows.label: Owner web chat
workflows.quote: Implementing Web Chat on your company website enables immediate and valuable communication between you, your owners, and and or owner prospects. Quicker and more convenient than email, owners can send you a Web Chat message that instantly appears in the My Conversations window of Rent Manager.

workflows.label: Owner-specific chat queues
workflows.quote: By structuring Web Chat so that these inquiries go to a specific owner’s queue, you can keep your chats organized and ensure that each question is answered by a staff member who understands their particular needs.

workflows.label: Owner ACH NACHA file creation
workflows.quote: This universal file type is used to request the transfer of funds electronically as an ACH and is easily generated in Rent Manager. NACHA files contain specific payment instructions for your bank and make the owner payout process quick and seamless.

workflows.label: Check and electronic owner distributions
workflows.quote: Beyond NACHA and ACH, you can pay your owners a specified amount or their full distribution via check or other electronic payment methods.

workflows.label: Integrated inbound and outbound voice calls
workflows.quote: Fully integrated with Rent Manager, rmVoIP allows you to make and receive calls directly from the software. Every call is recorded and automatically attaches a historical audio record to the contact’s History and Notes. If a new contact calls and you don’t have their information saved in the system, a few mouse clicks enable you to create them as a contact in your database. Provide clarity, eliminate “he said and she said” situations, and advance your business with every call.

workflows.label: Call audio original attached to contact history
workflows.quote: Fully integrated with Rent Manager, rmVoIP allows you to make and receive calls directly from the software. Every call is recorded and automatically attaches a historical audio record to the contact’s History and Notes. If a new contact calls and you don’t have their information saved in the system, a few mouse clicks enable you to create them as a contact in your database. Provide clarity, eliminate “he said and she said” situations, and advance your business with every call.

workflows.label: Unknown caller creation as native contact
workflows.quote: Fully integrated with Rent Manager, rmVoIP allows you to make and receive calls directly from the software. Every call is recorded and automatically attaches a historical audio record to the contact’s History and Notes. Provide clarity, eliminate “he said and she said” situations, and advance your business with every call.

workflows.label: Incoming caller history and record lookup
workflows.quote: You can instantly update tenant information with rmVoIp. Caller records open instantaneously when your phone rings, allowing you to easily identify call trends and histories.
